items.title: Reducing the cognitive load of AI changes
items.raw_excerpt: When reviewing large amounts of AI-generated code, I often find that the LLM chooses terms for abstractions that do not always map to my own choices. For instance, what it may call a MutationIntent might personally be more natural to me as an EditRequest . Because the LLM's choice of words is not my ideal choice, I have to do a mental lookup of what it means every time I see it, which adds cognitive load.

items.title: Portus, A Rust Based API/AI/MCP Gateway
items.raw_excerpt:
Portus is a Rust-based API/AI/MCP Gateway built on top of Rama as the networking stack (Rama replaced Pingora due to better throughput and lower resource usage). Portus uses a split control/data plane architecture and conforms with the Kubernetes Gateway API specification (130/130 tests across all profiles). Portus also runs in standalone mode outside of Kubernetes with a simple Yaml config file with ACME support built-in. Please give it a try and if you like it then if you wouldn't mind going to Github and starring the project I would be very appreciative!
If there is something missing that you would like to see then please leave feedback and I will see what I can do. Thank you! https://github.com/Portus-Gateway/Portus

This LDraw is literally an "assembly" language, a low-level programming language that describes how to assemble LEGO pieces together into models, one placement instruction at a time. items.raw_excerpt: The article examines the AI industry's bet that spending on artificial intelligence could eventually reach roughly 9% of U.S. GDP, and questions whether such a scale of investment is realistic or sustainable.

title_i18n.en: Will America Spend 9% of Its GDP on AI? The Industry Is Counting on It
title_i18n.zh: 美国会在人工智能上花费GDP的9%吗？业界正指望着这个。
title_i18n.es: ¿Gastará Estados Unidos el 9 % de su PIB en IA? La industria cuenta con ello.

excerpt_i18n.en: The article examines the AI industry's bet that spending on artificial intelligence could eventually reach roughly 9% of U.S. GDP, and questions whether such a scale of investment is realistic or sustainable.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 《华尔街日报》这篇文章探讨了美国人工智能产业对巨额投入的预期：业界寄望于AI相关支出最终能占到美国GDP的约9%。文章审视这一假设是否现实，以及如此规模的资本开支能否持续支撑行业的增长叙事。

items.title: People will be AI's app layer
items.raw_excerpt: The piece argues that as AI models grow more general, people themselves will become the "app layer" for AI—supplying context, judgment, and domain framing that turn raw model capability into real value. It suggests future products may center less on traditional apps and more on how humans orchestrate and apply models.

title_i18n.en: People will be AI's app layer
title_i18n.zh: 人类将成为 AI 的应用层
title_i18n.es: Las personas serán la capa de aplicaciones de la IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: The piece argues that as AI models grow more general, people themselves will become the "app layer" for AI—supplying context, judgment, and domain framing that turn raw model capability into real value. It suggests future products may center less on traditional apps and more on how humans orchestrate and apply models.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 该观点认为，随着 AI 模型能力不断通用化，传统应用层软件的中间角色将被削弱，人本身会成为 AI 的“应用层”——由人来理解具体场景、组织上下文并把模型能力落地为实际价值。作者由此提出，未来的产品形态可能不再以 App 为中心，而是围绕人如何调用与编排模型来展开。

items.title: Where AI learns to do real work
items.raw_excerpt: Labelbox discusses how AI can learn to perform real work, highlighting task-specific data, human feedback, and evaluation to bridge model training and real-world workflows.

title_i18n.en: Where AI learns to do real work

title_i18n.es: Donde la IA aprende a hacer trabajo real

excerpt_i18n.en: Labelbox discusses how AI can learn to perform real work, highlighting task-specific data, human feedback, and evaluation to bridge model training and real-world workflows.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Labelbox 聚焦于 AI 如何在真实工作任务中学习并可靠执行，强调面向实际场景的数据、人工反馈与评估环节。其平台旨在把模型训练与真实业务流程连接起来，帮助 AI 从演示走向可落地应用。

items.title: What if AI worked at 1.000.000 tokens per seconds?
items.raw_excerpt: An imagined speed, not a measurement: what one AI agent writing a million tokens a second would change, and why testing, evidence and judgment become the bottleneck.

title_i18n.en: What if AI worked at 1.000.000 tokens per seconds?
title_i18n.zh: 如果AI每秒能处理100万个token会怎样？
title_i18n.es: ¿Qué pasaría si la IA funcionara a 1.000.000 de tokens por segundo?

excerpt_i18n.en: An imagined speed, not a measurement: what one AI agent writing a million tokens a second would change, and why testing, evidence and judgment become the bottleneck.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一种想象的速度，而非实测值：若一个AI智能体每秒写一百万个词元，会改变什么，以及为何测试、证据和判断会成为瓶颈。
excerpt_i18n.es: Una velocidad imaginada, no una medición: lo que cambiaría un agente de IA que escribiera un millón de tokens por segundo, y por qué las pruebas, la evidencia y el juicio se convierten en el cuello de botella.
